stem: What is the main difference between Realtime and DebugView?

options.text: DebugView shows a detailed event stream for specific debug devices; Realtime summarises all users in the last 30 minutes
Realtime shows each event and its parameters for one chosen device; DebugView summarises all users over the last 24 hours
DebugView shows only key events from all users; Realtime shows every event from the last 30 minutes
DebugView covers the last 14 months of events, while Realtime covers only the last 30 minutes
